slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Too sore to lift the kids

caption:
Hours of Lego on the floor these school holidays, and Koko's back creaks every time she gets up.

The floor itself usually isn't the problem. It's staying folded in one position for too long. Switch between kneeling, side-sitting and lying on your tummy every few minutes, and bring puzzles up to the coffee table.

To get up: roll to your side, come onto hands and knees, step a foot forward and push up through your legs, using the couch for a hand. When lifting little ones, get close first and let your legs share the work.

Tingling down a leg or pain that keeps building is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
